limits: Host actions occur at guest instruction boundaries after the first committed CORE trim write. They are explicit synthetic scheduling stimuli, not observed device races.

Nested post handler executes original/source guest instructions on a separate guest stack and restores outer CPU context; memory effects persist. Maskable nesting is deferred under PRIMASK1. Forced nesting under mask1 models counterfactual/nonmaskable mutation only.
No allocator, scheduler or cancellation API is invented. Cancellation/republish are host byte changes. Source execution at original code addresses is forbidden.
